description: Agent Access: submit the rules a gateway or policy layer enforces, each with where it is written (policy document, decision record, versioned or unversioned configuration, code only or nowhere) and its source, its owner and owner type, when it last changed and was last reviewed, whether it is reviewed when the toolset changes and the tools it covers, plus the toolset with when it last changed and the tools it serves now. The signed report gives each rule written, owned and current, and names every rule written nowhere or held only in live configuration or code, owned by no one, by an agent or only as a vendor default, reviewed before the last toolset change or still naming retired tools, and not reviewed when the toolset changes. Which routes the gateway reaches is wever_gateway-coverage-check and which instruction governs one action is wever_policy-precedence-check. A summary sample is wever_gateway-rules-sample on https://weverlabs.com/mcp-free. Verdict unwritten_rules, rule_gaps, rules_unverified or rules_governed. POST /api/gateway-rules-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-access-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-access/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

rules.description: Each rule the gateway or policy layer enforces.

covers.description: Tools the rule applies to; leave out for every tool.

enforced_by.description: The gateway or policy layer that enforces it.

owner.description: The named party who owns the rule.

review_on_change.description: The rule is reviewed whenever the toolset changes.

reviewed.description: When the rule was last reviewed, as a date.

source.description: Where the written rule lives, such as a document or repository path.

updated.description: When the rule last changed, as a date.

written.description: Where the rule is written down.

changed.description: When the toolset last changed, as a date.

tools.description: The tools the gateway serves now.

name: wever_gateway-rules-check
title: Gateway rules check
